issue.body:
# Clarify Zhong2019 potassium-calcium sulfate identity and spectral labels

Source: Zhong Y, Qiu X, Gao J, Meng L, Guo Z (2019), *Recovery of Soluble Potassium from Alunite by Thermal Decomposition: Effect of CaO and Phase Transformation*, DOI **10.3390/met9030337**.

The complete current thirteen-page publisher v2 and official one-page supplement were acquired and independently inspected. This is a source clarification, not a new unsupported-record finding: the alunite owner already preserves these limits and separates soluble-K recovery from mixed-product composition.

Concrete questions:

- Section 3.1.2, equation (3), Figures 3–5 and their phase keys call written **K2Ca2(SO4)3** “syngenite.” Clarify the phase identity, hydration state, diffraction reference/card and peak assignment. Supply the underlying patterns or refined phase analysis if available; the current record does not assign a resolved mineral species to this written formula/name combination.
- The abstract and conclusion describe AlO6 as tetrahedral and AlO4 as octahedral, whereas section 3.2.2 and the ordinary coordination meanings are opposite. Clarify the intended spectral assignment and its evidential basis.
- Figure 6 visibly contains several CaO/alunite ratios while its caption specifies 0.4. Identify the correct sample conditions for each trace.

Accepted quantitative boundary remains about 81% soluble potassium at CaO/ore 0.1 and 700°C for two hours, measured against initial ore potassium. The separately characterized evaporation product is from the 0.2-ratio arm and is mixed; 40.42 wt% K2O equivalent is neither pure K2SO4 nor an isolated potassium mass yield. A clarification must not transfer results between those arms.

Access: official current PDF https://mdpi-res.com/metals/metals-09-00337/article_deploy/metals-09-00337-v2.pdf (SHA256 e506fb7c5be6af7ed8bdac826dc8e16f219a5a100666bb869aeb7e5286af4963); SI https://mdpi-res.com/d_attachment/metals/metals-09-00337/article_deploy/metals-09-00337-s001.pdf?version=1553598414 (SHA256 c8d13ee6db29e5d8b5a4f27b80798b9a3c37cb648f1b97c75ca1bb1ea64ff0bf). Current publisher version notes confirm a March 26, 2019 updated PDF. The visible v2 Figure 3 correctly says CaO and 0.2; stale hidden PDF text is not being reported as a visible error.

Acceptance: acquire a public primary clarification/correction or source-linked original diffraction/spectral metadata resolving these exact assignments, assess it against the bounded owner, and amend only supported claims with new provenance/review. No author contact was performed or authorized by this draft. Search of root's all-state snapshots and hidden/ignored/followed maintained roots found no earlier matching DOI issue before this round; root should repeat live duplicate checking before posting.
issue.title: Clarify Zhong2019 potassium-calcium sulfate and spectral assignments

dedup.disposition: No earlier source clarification. Issue339, where present, concerns only the maintained record locator and has separate acceptance.
